out_of_hospital_midwife.kit_ordering: Out-of-hospital providers (midwives, physicians) order newborn screening specimen collection kits and supplies from the Georgia Public Health Laboratory; screening is not done at birth centers. Kits are requested through the NBS provider portal / GPHL.
out_of_hospital_midwife.submission_deadline: Blood specimen collected 24+ hours after birth (preferably 48 hours) and transported to GPHL; repeat screen at 2 weeks if first collected before 24 hours.
out_of_hospital_midwife.specimen_tracking: Results returned to the ordering provider; parents receive results through their provider. Tracking via the NBS provider portal.

metabolic_screening.opt_out_form_number: Declaration of Religious Objection to Newborn Screening (DPH-NBS refusal form)
metabolic_screening.state_form_note: Georgia provides an official 'Declaration of Religious Objection to Newborn Screening' form. Per O.C.G.A. Â§ 31-12-6(h), newborn screening may be declined only on religious grounds; the signed declaration is filed with the provider and GPHL. Non-religious refusal is not permitted under state law.
metabolic_screening.statute: O.C.G.A. Â§ 31-12-6(h) (religious exemption); Ga. Comp. R. & Regs. R. 511-5-3 (newborn screening)

hearing_screening.program_name: Georgia Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI)
hearing_screening.out_of_hospital_path: For home/birth-center births, the midwife or physician collects and submits the newborn hearing screen (or refers to an audiologist), and documents any refusal in the medical record. Out-of-hospital births are reported per the same NBS provider pathway.
hearing_screening.statute: O.C.G.A. Â§ 31-12-6 (newborn screening, includes hearing); Georgia EHDI 1-3-6 benchmarks

cchd_screening.out_of_hospital_performer: The attending midwife or physician performs pulse oximetry (CCHD) in the out-of-hospital setting and documents it; refusal documented in the medical record.
cchd_screening.statute: Georgia Rule R. 511-5-3 (includes CCHD pulse-oximetry screening)

erythromycin_eye_ointment.statute: Georgia Comp. R. & Regs. R. 511-5-3 (Rules of Dept. of Public Health)
erythromycin_eye_ointment.waiver: Administration may be declined; the parent must sign a refusal, and the attending professional documents the refusal in the medical record. Georgia does not provide a standalone 'waiver' beyond the documented informed refusal.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.note: Prophylactic eye treatment (0.5% erythromycin) applied to each eye shortly after birth to prevent ophthalmia neonatorum.

vitamin_k.note: Georgia does not mandate vitamin K; parental choice of oral, intramuscular shot, or decline, documented in the birth record.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.birth_dose_registry: Georgia Registry of Immunization Transactions and Services (GRITS)
hepatitis_b_vaccine.note: Birth dose reported to GRITS by birthing facilities; infants born to HBsAg-positive mothers are referred for Hepatitis B case management.

gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Licensed midwives in Georgia provide gestational diabetes screening/counseling in prenatal care and refer for diagnostic testing when indicated.
gestational_diabetes.note: Prenatal informed-choice item; no state newborn-screening form.

group_b_strep.midwife_role: Licensed midwives offer GBS screening in late pregnancy and arrange intrapartum prophylaxis per protocol for out-of-hospital births when indicated.
group_b_strep.note: Prenatal informed-choice item; no state newborn-screening form.
